decisions.reason: As a specialist naval line with long procurement and qualification cycles that fits the firm's rugged application-specific capabilities, it is worth keeping the option open while market adoption continues to unfold.

The desk lamp remains the most peripheral and competitively exposed offer in the set, but its ergonomic relevance for office and education users and relatively low continuation cost still justify waiting for clearer evidence.

A general interior luminaire sits directly in the firm's core LED building-lighting business, so continued market presence after the initial launch phase supports retaining it and harvesting further learning.

Because this pendant luminaire was positioned as a flagship for the firm's strategic move toward efficient, application-focused modern lighting, management would be very reluctant to withdraw it absent clear negative signals.
